mechanism_narrative: A lower level of the federal funds rate (as of the latest available data) compresses discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of observations when FEDFUNDS < 4.5%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate exceeding 5.0% signals aggressive monetary tightening, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, which produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 5.0%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate weakening consumer demand, triggering reduced corporate revenue expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline (relative to prior month), or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: High labor market tightness (UNRATE < 4.0% and PAYEMS growth > 150k jobs) correlates with inflationary pressures and imminent monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE < 4.0% and PAYEMS growth > 150k, or the Rank IC for the regime condition is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A lower unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates stronger labor market conditions, supporting corporate earnings growth and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of observations when UNRATE < 4.0%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts below 1300.0 (thousands of units) signal a deteriorating housing market, reducing consumer spending and economic growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when HOUST < 1300.0, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in industrial production (INDPRO) and quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) indicate economic contraction, reducing corporate profits and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when both INDPRO and GDPC1 decline (relative to prior period), or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production (INDPRO < 100, index 2017=100) signals manufacturing slowdown and economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO < 100, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.
